_about: Upgrade definitions (F22, TDD 'Upgrades & abilities'; F34: ranks 2–9 as decided in design/upgrades-map.md 'F33 decisions'). type: passive = modifiers (always on) · active = an ability you equip, charge and fire · feature = a flag the screens read. rank = the rank it can be bought from (the shop itself opens at progression.json unlocks.upgrades). maxLevel = how many levels; cost = scraps a level (missing = 1, v1's price). byLevel[n-1] = the value AT level n (not added up). Passive effects: modifier = a name from src/engine/upgrades.ts Modifiers (or a repair's fewer steps), op = 'mul' (multiply) or 'add'. Abilities: charge 0..1 (1 = ready), chargePerSecond while the shift is playing, chargePerSeal per crack sealed; byLevel = the effect's numbers. cardNumber 'count' = the shop card shows an active's first number as it is (1 → 2 waves), not as a %. Features: feature = the flag the game reads; upgrades on the same flag add up (abilitySlots: each adds an active slot). What players READ (names, descriptions) is in content/text/en.json upgrades.items — 'name' here is only a label for whoever edits this file. Per-level steps start at v1's and get checked by the bots / economy sim (F51). testOnly upgrades are for tests only: nothing in the game lists or grants them.

upgrades.name: Circuit Stabilizer
upgrades._note: v1: +0.75 s of a 5 s grace a level = +15%. Max level: the visor's repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Auto-Popper
upgrades._note: F33 decision 3 (Muzzy's idea): slower depressurise after a rupture, +15% drain time a level.

upgrades.name: Capacitor Efficiency
upgrades._note: v1: laser drain × (1 − 0.0625 × level). Max level: the laser's repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Cooldown Booster
upgrades._note: Active. v1: full in 20 s (0.05 a second) + 25% per seal. Fire: every running machine's calm time (the cooldown before it can break again) grows by boost × what's left: +25 / 35 / 50%. The fire effect is F34 task 6.

upgrades.name: Gear Lubrication
upgrades._note: v1: heat drains × (1 + 0.125 × level). Max level: the controls' repair takes 1 step less.

upgrades.name: Focus Mode
upgrades._note: v1: time × (1 − 0.1 × level) at the console. Here: × breakdowns.json consoleTimeScale while you're at the console mid-shift (the App reads it — F34 task 5). Muzzy 2026-10-29: the console runs at 75%, Focus Mode knocks it to 50% then 25% ("freeing up scrap is good"). Muzzy 2026-10-30 (F52): split into two 1-level upgrades — this one (75% → 50%) and Focus Mode II at 31 (→ 25%); the two multiply.

upgrades.name: Dense Goop
upgrades._note: v1: fall speed × (1 + 0.125 × level). A self-chosen challenge you can take back.

upgrades.name: Pressure Control
upgrades._note: F33 decision 2: pressure rises slower (pressureRiseTimeMult > 1 = slower, src/engine/shift.ts), and cracks follow pressure. 8 levels = the scrap sink. F52 (balance pass): level 1 is +12% so one level is felt (+6–8 s for the Focused/Sharp bots; +5% was +2–3 s), then +4% a level to the same max (+40%).

upgrades.name: Junk Uniformer
upgrades._note: F43 (v1): the starting junk. The first junk cell's colour is random; each later one copies it with this chance — v1: 0.10 a level. One extra roll a cell, only when owned (no upgrade = the same junk with the same seed).

upgrades.name: Goop Swap
upgrades._note: F43 (v1): the hold-to-swap gets shorter. v1: 1.5 s − 0.25 s a level → 1.25 / 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 s = × 0.8333 / 0.6667 / 0.5 / 0.3333 of tank.json holdToSwapMs (1500). Never under tank.json holdToSwapMinMs (500, v1's floor). Read by the input layer (src/input/controls.ts), not the engine: the held key's Swap bar and the finger's ring both follow it.

upgrades.name: Goop Dump
upgrades._note: Active (F42, v1). Full in 15 s (0.0667 a second) + 25% per seal. Fire: waves of single WILD goop cells (F75, Muzzy 2026-10-30: they plug any crack; was the falling piece's colour) rain into random columns — in the final shift into the columns with an open crack (none: random) — waves 1 / 2 / 3, cellsPerWave cells a wave (v1 18; F75 task 8: 4 — wild rain at 8 made careers ~57 shifts and ranks 40–49 ~99% met; at 4 ~62 shifts, 80–95% met; F52 balance pass: 8 — 18 added +30–37k score a shift at level 3, 4–5 ranks of XP; 8 adds about one rank's worth), cellMs between cells (v1 80), waveMs between waves (v1 600). Seeded. Refused (charge kept) during a rupture or while a dump is still raining (F75: it copies no colour now, so it fires with no falling piece or a wild one). cardNumber 'count': the shop card shows the first number (waves) as a plain number, not a %.

upgrades.name: Sealing Bonus
upgrades._note: F43, Muzzy's pick (2026-10-26): each sealed crack adds EXTRA active charge — × every equipped active's chargePerSeal, +15% a level (0.25 a seal → 0.4 at max). v1's code cut breakdown cooldowns instead, which brought breakdowns back sooner (a bug).

upgrades.name: Active Expansion Slot
upgrades._note: Feature (F42, v1). Owning it = one more active slot (2 with this, 3 with Active Expansion Slot 2 too). Every upgrade with feature 'abilitySlots' adds its level to progression.json activeSlots. Taking it back unequips the active equipped longest if they no longer fit.

upgrades.name: Tougher Tank
upgrades._note: F43 / F33 decision 6 (Muzzy's idea): open cracks wear the tank slower — × integrity.drainPerCrackPerSec, −12.5% a level (half the wear at max). Arrives with split two-colour pieces (20). Not in v1 (rank 22 was Goop Hold Viewer, retired by F59).

upgrades.name: Goop Colorizer
upgrades._note: Active (F42, v1). Full in 25 s (0.04 a second) + 25% per seal. Fire: the next 2 / 3 / 4 pieces (from the one in the next window on) take the falling piece's colour (a two-colour piece: its main colour — the one most of its cells have). Refused (charge kept) with no falling piece or a wild one. Firing again starts the count again in the new colour. F52 (balance pass): a short burst toward a crack — v1's 6 / 7 / 8 built one-colour blobs too big to pop in time (the bots lost 4–9% of the quota; with Goop Dump the score was wiped to 0 in 65–98% of shifts).

upgrades.name: Quick Fix
upgrades._note: F48 (Muzzy 2026-10-18, rank 28 = the slot Goop Window left): every console repair takes 1 / 2 fewer steps (laser sliders, visor buttons, dial corners). Adds to the max-level machine fixes; never below 1 step (src/game/repairs.ts repairSteps). cardNumber 'count': the card shows the steps as a plain number.

upgrades.name: Slow Cracks
upgrades._note: F43: new cracks come less often — × the time between cracks, +15% a level — and the same number stretches each crack cell's growth roll (F39, twists.ts), so growing cracks spread slower too. v1 only slowed the growth (−5% spread chance a level). F75 (Muzzy 2026-10-30): in the final shift only the spreading slows — new cracks come as often as without it (the boss level's onslaught stays).

upgrades.name: Focus Mode II
upgrades._note: F52 (Muzzy 2026-10-30): Focus Mode's old level 2 as its own upgrade. × Focus Mode's 0.6667 (the two multiply): the console 50% → 25%; the final shift 25% → 16.7% → 8.3% (finalShift.json consoleTimeScale).

upgrades.name: Crack Matcher
upgrades._note: F43 (v1): each new piece takes the colour of the lowest open crack (not yet plugged) with this chance — v1: 0.25 a level. A two-colour piece: its main colour's cells; a wild piece stays wild. It's the piece made for the next window, so the window shows it. One extra roll, only when owned and a crack is open.

upgrades.name: Crack Down
upgrades._note: Active (F42, v1). Full in 30 s (0.0333 a second) + 25% per seal. Fire: the next 3 / 5 / 7 cracks form in the bottom `rows` rows (v1 4; no room there → a normal crack, which doesn't count). Refused (charge kept) during a rupture (no new cracks then).

upgrades.name: Active Expansion Slot 2
upgrades._note: Feature (F42, v1): one more active slot (3 with both slot upgrades).

upgrades.name: Sturdy tank (test)
upgrades.desc: Open cracks wear the tank 50% slower.

upgrades.name: Low cracks (test)
upgrades.desc: When fired, the next 3 cracks form in the bottom 4 rows.
upgrades._note: The F22 plumbing proof, kept for tests: the same effect as Crack Down, but charged only by seals (no time), so the tests are exact.
